intent: reference-guided sprite generation; deterministic packing and WebP encoding

characters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production transparent desktop-companion sprite atlas, NOT a concept presentation. Make ONE consistent original adult anime woman from the reference, simplified polished cel shading, clear expressive face, compact four-head-tall proportions, dignified adult styling. Exactly 4 equal columns and 5 equal rows, exactly 20 separate FULL BODY figures, on a genuinely transparent RGBA background. Desired canvas 1024x1600, each invisible cell 256x320; no borders, labels, writing, watermark or scene. Every cell has the SAME front-facing camera, figure scale, horizontal center and ground baseline, at least 20px clear padding, entire hair and shoes visible. All poses are standing, even sleep. Four cells in a row are consecutive SUBTLE animation frames of the same pose, not different outfits. Row 1: idle, eyes open/open/brief blink/open, arms relaxed. Row 2: happy, soft smile growing, one gentle hand wave in four tiny steps, no jumping. Row 3: caring comfort after a learning mistake, concerned eyebrows, small open-palm reassuring gesture, never angry or distressed, four small stages. Row 4: peaceful resting, closed eyes, hands folded at waist, tiny breathing changes. Row 5: tapped greeting with personality, four small changes of expression and small hand gesture. No particles or props detached outside the body. Keep shoulders/neck at the same height for accessory overlays. Preserve exact clothing and identity in every cell. Original character only, no existing IP. Reference image is identity and outfit guidance only, do not reproduce its layout. Lison age24: SILVER WHITE short bob with a SINGLE folded-page point on HER LEFT (viewer right), blue irises, red modest short-sleeved shirt-dress to knees, cream collar/cuffs/buttons, thin navy belt and navy sneakers, small cream envelope crossbody satchel. Clever sweet but sly personality: slightly asymmetric knowing smile; tapped row uses amused half-lidded playful expression, not sinister. Hair stays silver-white, eyes stay blue. All 20 cells fully separate and consistently aligned.

accessories.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game-accessory atlas matching clean cel-shaded original anime sprites. A truly transparent RGBA backdrop, exactly THREE columns ONE row, evenly spaced, each invisible cell has just one isolated accessory seen straight front, no character, no mannequin, no text, no shadows on background. Left: a small elegant gold bookmark-shaped brooch, cream center, tiny blue enamel corner, clear outline. Middle: a small sideways hair barrette shaped like two folded cream book pages with a fine gold edge, simple distinctive silhouette. Right: a short wearable deep NAVY shoulder capelet/shawl with a GOLD edge, open small neck hole, gold front clasp, tailored fabric draping over BOTH shoulders in a symmetrical shallow arc; it covers shoulders and upper chest only, not waist, not head, no sleeves/arms. All objects must be complete with substantial transparent padding, polished crisp cel shading and simple flat colors, readable when tiny, no sparkles, no brand, no lettering, no existing IP. Broad horizontal atlas layout.
